report.summary: Convert 5 reviewed findings into ordered work items. Paths must exist in the index; settling checks provide file references. Items are ranked by severity and dependency. Gate 0 for critical path leak, Gate 1 for high-severity validation gaps, Gate 2 for medium issues. Assumptions noted where paths are unknown.
risks: Assumption that _ABBREV_SHA_RE allows <7 characters; if not, item is low priority.
Assumption that mint_task_from_landed_edit is defined in daedalus/eval/mint.py; if not, path is UNKNOWN.
Assumption that main() in picker.py does not enforce dry-run; if it does, item is moot.
Assumption that drift.py test file exists; if not, settling check may fail.
Assumption that _is_linked_worktree can have false negatives; if not, item is lower severity.
todos: Inspect mint_task_from_landed_edit in daedalus/eval/mint.py for validation.
Grep for 'def main' in daedalus/spine/picker.py to check dry-run enforcement.

items.title: Prevent linked worktree path leak in mint_from_diffs
items.why_now: Critical severity: if _is_linked_worktree returns false negative, absolute paths stored in minted tasks become unresolvable after worktree deletion, breaking task resolution.

steps.do: Add a test that creates a linked worktree, mints a task, deletes the worktree, and verifies resolve_task_repo returns None gracefully.
If test fails, harden _is_linked_worktree in daedalus/eval/mint.py to detect edge cases (e.g., race conditions, unusual git layouts).

items.assumption: Assumes _is_linked_worktree is in daedalus/eval/mint.py; if not, path is UNKNOWN.

items.title: Add validation of report['wrote'] in mint_task_from_landed_edit
items.why_now: High severity: missing validation makes minting fragile to changes in offload.py's output format, potentially causing silent failures or incorrect minting.

steps.do: Locate mint_task_from_landed_edit in daedalus/eval/mint.py and add type/schema validation for report['wrote'] (must be a list of strings).
Write a test that passes a malformed report (e.g., wrote=None) and expects a clear error.

items.assumption: Assumes mint_task_from_landed_edit is in daedalus/eval/mint.py; if not, path is UNKNOWN.

items.title: Fix accepted island suppression in drift.py
items.why_now: High severity: accepted islands are incorrectly classified as NEW_ISLAND, suppressing legitimate drift findings and potentially hiding regressions.

steps.do: Write a unit test for drift.py that creates a snapshot with an accepted island and verifies it is not suppressed in BECAME ISLAND.
If test fails, modify daedalus/mapping/drift.py to exclude accepted keys from known_unreached before computing was_reached.

items.assumption: Assumes drift.py test file exists; if not, create it.

items.title: Enforce dry-run as default in picker.py main()
items.why_now: Medium severity: if main() does not enforce dry-run default, operators may inadvertently trigger actions, leading to unintended modifications.

steps.do: Grep for 'def main' in daedalus/spine/picker.py and inspect whether it enforces dry-run (e.g., no --apply flag, default action is dry-run).
steps.verified_by: Manual inspection; if not enforced, add logic to default to dry-run.

steps.do: Write a test that invokes main() with no flags and verifies no side effects occur.

items.assumption: Assumes main() is in daedalus/spine/picker.py and test file exists.

items.title: Clarify _ABBREV_SHA_RE minimum length and test prefix collision
items.why_now: Medium severity: if regex allows fewer than 7 hex chars, prefix matching can cause false freshness, leading to incorrect snapshot acceptance.

steps.do: Print the regex pattern for _ABBREV_SHA_RE from daedalus/spine/picker.py and check minimum length.
steps.verified_by: Manual inspection; if <7, update regex to require at least 7 hex chars.

steps.do: Write a test with recorded='a' and actual='abcdef1' to verify startswith does not pass.

items.assumption: Assumes _ABBREV_SHA_RE is defined in daedalus/spine/picker.py; if not, path is UNKNOWN.
